title: RAG-NIMBF: A Non-Invasive, Modular Benchmarking Framework for Automated RAG Configuration Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.27816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the dominant paradigm for grounding the outputs of large language models (LLM) in external knowledge. However, practitioners are faced with a vast configuration space comprising chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, prompting and generation models, and there is limited guidance on how these components interact. We present RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer. It evaluates the configuration space through controlled ablation with end-to-end experiment tracking. The evaluation combines LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators. This study validates the framework across multiple generation models on the SQuAD dataset. This process reveals non-obvious interactions and demonstrates how the experiments are tracked. translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为将大语言模型（LLM）的输出锚定于外部知识的主流范式。然而，从业者面临着由分块、嵌入、检索、重排序、提示和生成模型组成的庞大配置空间，而关于这些组件之间如何相互作用的指导却十分有限。我们提出了RAG-NIMBF，这是一个模块化的基准测试框架，它作为非侵入式评估层附加到现有的RAG管道上。该框架通过受控消融实验和端到端的实验跟踪来评估配置空间。评估结合了基于LLM的答案质量评分、检索正确性度量以及运行时指标。本研究在SQuAD数据集上通过多个生成模型对该框架进行了验证。这一过程揭示了非显而易见的组件交互作用，并展示了实验跟踪的实现方式。研究结果表明，检索平衡...
tldr: 该论文提出了RAG-NIMBF，一个可作为非侵入式评估层附加到现有RAG管道的模块化基准测试框架，通过受控消融实验与端到端实验跟踪，结合LLM答案质量评分、检索正确性和运行时指标，自动分析RAG庞大配置空间中各组件间的非显而易见的交互作用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RAG-NIMBF, a modular benchmarking framework that attaches to existing RAG pipelines as a non-invasive evaluation layer, automatically analyzing the vast RAG configuration space through controlled ablation and end-to-end experiment tracking by combining LLM-based answer quality scores, retrieval correctness measures, and runtime indicators to reveal non-obvious component interactions.
